title: Teatro de Autores Portugueses do Séc. XVI
notes: Textual database of critical editions of 16th-century Portuguese theatre by the Centro de Estudos de Teatro (ULisboa). The live obras page (ver http://cet-e-quinhentos.com/obras, 200) lists the exact collected autos, including 'Auto de Santiago' by Afonso Álvares and 'Auto das Padeiras' (Anónimo). HTML site with critical apparatus/glossary/facsimiles (not TEI). Licence not stated. Origin verbatim: 'CET 16c PT theatre: Afonso Álvares — Auto de Santiago'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Centro de Estudos de Teatro (CET), Faculdade de Letras da Universidade de Lisboa, dir. José Camões (FCT project POCTI/ELT/33464/2000)
